```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

set.seed(42)
analysis_start_time <- Sys.time()
message("Starting RNA-seq shRNA at: ", analysis_start_time)
```

## Configuration and Setup

```{r configuration}
config <- list(
  filtering = list(
    abs_filt_samples = 2,
    min_count_threshold = 10
  ),
  statistical = list(
    padj_cutoff = 0.05,
    log2FC_cutoff = 1,
    var_expl_needed = 0.6
  ),
  visualization = list(
    ntop_genes_pca = 1000,
    plot_width = 20,
    plot_height = 20,
    plot_units = "cm",
    top_pathways_show = 20
  ),
  fgsea = list(
    min_size = 15,
    max_size = 500
  )
)

PATHS <- list(
  data_dir = here::here("neuroblastoma", "data", "RNAseq"),
  results_dir = here::here("neuroblastoma", "results", "RNA-seq_shRNA"),
  resources_dir = here::here("neuroblastoma", "resources")
)

print("Configuration loaded successfully")
```

```{r load_libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  # Core analysis packages
  library(DESeq2)
  library(stringr)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  
  # Enrichment analysis
  library(fgsea)
  library(hypeR)
  library(GSVA)
  
  # Visualization
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  
  # Data manipulation
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  
  # Batch correction
  library(limma)
  
  # File operations
  library(openxlsx)
  library(openxlsx2)
  library(here)
  
  # Load all utility functions from consolidated script
  source(here::here("neuroblastoma/resources/UtilityScriptsRNA-seq.R"))
})

print("Libraries loaded successfully")
```


```{r setup_environment}
if(!dir.exists(PATHS$results_dir)) dir.create(PATHS$results_dir, recursive = TRUE)
# Load gene sets directly (no caching to avoid repository bloat)
message("Loading gene sets from MSigDB...")
gs_hallmark <- hypeR::msigdb_gsets(species = "Homo sapiens", category = c("H"), clean = TRUE)
gs_C2_kegg <- hypeR::msigdb_gsets(species = "Homo sapiens", category = c("C2"), subcategory = "CP:KEGG", clean = TRUE)
gs_C2_reactome <- hypeR::msigdb_gsets(species = "Homo sapiens", category = c("C2"), subcategory = "CP:REACTOME", clean = TRUE)
gs_C5_GOBP <- hypeR::msigdb_gsets(species = "Homo sapiens", category = c("C5"), subcategory = "GO:BP", clean = TRUE)
gs_C5_GOCC <- hypeR::msigdb_gsets(species = "Homo sapiens", category = c("C5"), subcategory = "GO:CC", clean = TRUE)
gs_C5_GOMF <- hypeR::msigdb_gsets(species = "Homo sapiens", category = c("C5"), subcategory = "GO:MF", clean = TRUE)
gs_C6_onco <- hypeR::msigdb_gsets(species = "Homo sapiens", category = c("C6"), clean = TRUE)
gs_wang_hippo <- list(wang_hippo_set = c("CCN1", "CCN2", "AMOTL2", "ANKRD1", "IGFBP3", "F3", "FJX1", "NUAK2", "LATS2", "CRIM1", "GADD45A",
                                         "TGFB2", "PTPN14", "NT5E", "FOXF2", "AXL", "DOCK5", "ASAP1", "RBMS3", "MYOF", "ARHGEF17", "CCDC80"))

print("Environment setup completed")
```


## Data Loading and Preparation

```{r load_data}
message("Loading sh RNA-seq  data...")

annotation_data <- read.table(
  file = file.path(PATHS$data_dir, "rnaseq_deseq_global_annotation_gene.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
)
colnames(annotation_data)[c(5, 7)] <- c("ensembl_id", "gene_symbol")

# Load WWTR1 overexpression data with validation
load(file.path(PATHS$data_dir, "deseq2_shRNA.dds.RData"))
dds_reduced <- dds[, c(2,4,6)]
dds_reduced$Group3 <- factor(c("ctrl", "ctrl", "dox"), levels = c("ctrl", "dox"))
design(dds_reduced) <- as.formula("~ Group3")
```

```{r}
# make PCA with ALL samples
# Filtering lowly expressed genes
dds_reduced_filt <- filterDatasets(dds_reduced,
                               abs_filt = TRUE,
                               abs_filt_samples = config$filtering$abs_filt_samples
)

# Estimate size factors and running DESEQ2
dds_reduced_filt <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds_reduced_filt)
dds_reduced_filt <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds_reduced_filt)
dds_reduced_filt_vsd <- DESeq2::vst(dds_reduced_filt, blind = TRUE) # blind = TRUE for QC

resultsNames(dds_reduced_filt)
```

```{r Get DEGs, include=FALSE}
deg_results <- generateResults(
  dds_object = dds_reduced_filt,
  coeff_name = "Group3_dox_vs_ctrl",
  cond_numerator = "dox",
  cond_denominator = "ctrl",
  cond_variable = "Group3",
  ensemblAnnot = annotation_data,
  log2FC_cutoff = config$statistical$log2FC_cutoff
)

# Write the result to the xlsx file
XLSX_OUT <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "results_signif")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "de_details")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "results_all")
openxlsx::writeData(XLSX_OUT, x = deg_results$results_signif, sheet = "results_signif")
openxlsx::writeData(XLSX_OUT, x = deg_results$de_details, sheet = "de_details")
openxlsx::writeData(XLSX_OUT, x = deg_results$results_all, sheet = "results_all")
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(XLSX_OUT, file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "YAP_dox_vs_ctrl.xlsx"), overwrite = T)

```

```{r}
gene_set_list <- list(
  GOBP_Hippo_Signaling = gs_C5_GOBP[["genesets"]][["Hippo Signaling"]],
  REACTOME_Signaling_By_Hippo = gs_C2_reactome[["genesets"]][["Signaling By Hippo"]],
  C6_onko_Cordenonsi_Yap_Conserved_Signature = gs_C6_onco[["genesets"]][["Cordenonsi Yap Conserved Signature"]],
  Hippo_Wang = gs_wang_hippo$wang_hippo_set
)

# TDI_vs_DMSO
deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked <- deg_results$results_all
deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked <- deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  slice_max(baseMean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked <- deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked %>% arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))
deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked <- setNames(c(deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked$log2FoldChange),
                                           c(deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked$gene_symbol))


fgseaRes_YAPdox_vs_ctrl <- fgsea(
  pathways = gene_set_list,
  stats = deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked,
  minSize = 15,
  maxSize = 2500
)

for(gene_set_to_plot_name in names(gene_set_list)){
  # gene_set_to_plot_name <- "Cordenonsi_Yap_Conserved_Signature"
  gene_set_to_plot <- gene_set_list[[gene_set_to_plot_name]]
  
  title_values <- fgseaRes_YAPdox_vs_ctrl %>% dplyr::filter(pathway == gene_set_to_plot_name) %>% dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj)
  p <- plotEnrichment(pathway = gene_set_to_plot, stats = deg_results_YAPdox_vs_ctrl_ranked) + 
    labs(title = paste(title_values$pathway, "\n",
                       "NES =", title_values$NES, "\n",
                       "padj = ", title_values$padj))
  
 plot(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(PATHS$results_dir, paste0("yap_vs_dox_fgsea_", gene_set_to_plot_name, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm"
  )
}
```

```{r}
RNA_SEQ_data <- openxlsx2::read_xlsx("~/workspace/neuroblastoma/results/RNA-seq/cell_type_MES_vs_ADR.xlsx", sheet = 1)
mes_adrn_gene_list <- RNA_SEQ_data %>%
  mutate(Term = if_else(log2FoldChange < 0, "ADRN", "MES"))
sig_list_our_data <- list(
  Aderenergic = mes_adrn_gene_list$gene_symbol[mes_adrn_gene_list$Term == "ADRN"],
  Mesenchymal = mes_adrn_gene_list$gene_symbol[mes_adrn_gene_list$Term == "MES"]
)

# prepare vsd
vsd_counts_matrix <- assay(dds_reduced_filt_vsd)
row.names(vsd_counts_matrix) <- annotation_data[, 'gene_symbol'][match(row.names(vsd_counts_matrix), 
                                                                      annotation_data[, 'ensembl_id'])]

# Plot terms based on terms defined from RNA-seq profiles obtained from our RNA seq
ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines <- GSVA::gsva(vsd_counts_matrix,
                                      sig_list_our_data,
                                      method=c("ssgsea"),
                                      min.sz=1, 
                                      max.sz=Inf, 
                                      ssgsea.norm=TRUE, 
                                      verbose=TRUE, 
                                      parallel.sz=10)
ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines,
                                                        scale = "row",
                                                        #annotation_col = heatmap_col_annot_DTC,
                                                        cluster_rows = TRUE,
                                                        cluster_cols = FALSE,
                                                        color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
                                                        show_colnames = TRUE)

```

```{r plot_gsva_heatmap}
ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap
```

## Data Loading and Preparation

```{r load_data}
message("Loading sh RNA-seq  data...")

annotation_data <- read.table(
  file = file.path(PATHS$data_dir, "rnaseq_deseq_global_annotation_gene.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
)
colnames(annotation_data)[c(5, 7)] <- c("ensembl_id", "gene_symbol")

# Load WWTR1 overexpression data with validation
load(file.path(PATHS$data_dir, "deseq2_shRNA.dds.RData"))
dds_reduced <- dds
dds_reduced$Group3 <- factor(c("ctrl", "dox", "ctrl", "dox","ctrl", "dox"), levels = c("ctrl", "dox"))
dds_reduced$Group1 <- factor(c(dds_reduced$Group1), levels = unique(dds_reduced$Group1))
```

```{r}
# make PCA with ALL samples
# Filtering lowly expressed genes
dds_reduced_filt <- filterDatasets(dds_reduced,
                                   abs_filt = TRUE,
                                   abs_filt_samples = config$filtering$abs_filt_samples
)

resultsNames(dds_reduced_filt)
```

```{r Get DEGs, include=FALSE}

)

# Write the result to the xlsx file

openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "de_details")

openxlsx::saveWorkbook(XLSX_OUT, file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "YAP_dox_vs_ctrl.xlsx"), overwrite = T)

```
